preconditions: A3 landscape logical sheet 420 x 297 mm
native plot device exposes paper size and margins
model and annotation viewports share a uniform paper transform

variables.pw,ph: landscape media width and height, mm
variables.xp,yp: paper coordinates from printable lower-left, mm

decisionLogic: Reject insufficient printable area. Transform both viewport apertures while retaining model geometry/cameras. Author text/legend in model space. Inset frame inside annotation viewport. Validate persistence and actual PDFs separately.
implementationChoices: 2 mm safety inset, 0.8 minimum scale and 0.5% whole-page ink-balance gate are project choices, not universal drafting standards.
uncertainty: Native driver validation performed for the installed AutoCAD 2027 A3 PDF path only; no geological validity follows.
exclusions: Profile imports or persistent personal settings changes

validationMethod.positive: r6 native save/reopen and four printed PDFs
validationMethod.boundary: Expected rejection below 0.8 or above 1.01; synthetic threshold specification, not a native driver boundary test
validationMethod.negative: r1-r4 actual title clipping; r2 Window setup rejected
validationMethod.missingData: Missing PDF device/A3 media must refuse
validationMethod.conflictingEvidence: Native pass cannot override visual clipping

reopenCondition: Different driver/media/font/paper size or any output clipping
